sound_library_assets_quarantine_chk.name: sound_library_assets_quarantine_chk
sound_library_assets_quarantine_chk.value: ("sound_library_assets"."status" = 'active' and "sound_library_assets"."quarantine_reason" is null and "sound_library_assets"."quarantined_at" is null) or ("sound_library_assets"."status" = 'quarantined' and "sound_library_assets"."quarantine_reason" is not null and "sound_library_assets"."quarantined_at" is not null)

support_levels_duration_days_chk.name: support_levels_duration_days_chk
support_levels_duration_days_chk.value: ("support_levels"."privilege_duration" = 'days' and "support_levels"."privilege_duration_days" between 1 and 3650) or ("support_levels"."privilege_duration" <> 'days' and "support_levels"."privilege_duration_days" is null)
